rationale: First-cut sizing: I_tail = 60 uA (mn4=4) for SR_tail = 60 V/us > 30 V/us; I_2 = 330 uA (mn5=22) for SR_out = 30 V/us; S_mp3/S_mp1 = 11 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4 for balance; Cc = 1 pF and mn1 = 8 (W=2um) for UGBW ~ 110 MHz; Rc = 800 ohm moves RHP zero to LHP for PM > 60 deg.

Double wp3 and wp1 to 2.0 um to boost gm6 and raise p2 above 65 MHz while preserving balance ratio 11; increase mn1 to 12 for gm1 > 0.7 mS (ugbw > 100 MHz); set res = 1200 ohm for LHP zero phase lead at ~160 MHz to achieve PM > 60 deg.

Increase I_tail to 111 uA (mn4=8) to boost gm1; maintain balance ratio 12 (mp3=12, wp3=2um, mn5=24, wn5=2um, mp1=2, wp1=1um); reduce Cc to 0.7 pF and set res=1800 ohm to position LHP zero at ~146 MHz; expect UGBW 61.4 MHz -> >115 MHz, PM 60.95 -> >61 deg, achieving full feasibility.

Increase mn3 from 2 to 3 to lower both mirror currents to I_tail=74.9uA and I_2=469.2uA while preserving balance ratio 12; reduce Cc from 0.7pF to 0.6pF and raise res to 2400 ohm for LHP zero at 125 MHz; expect current 831.7uA -> 574.1uA, UGBW ~104 MHz, PM ~60.8 deg, FoM 0.3423 -> ~0.465.
